description: This file defines the MediaSourceInterface interface for Drupal media source plugins, outlining methods for handling media metadata, source fields, display preparation, and source value retrieval.

classes.name: MediaSourceInterface
classes.description: Interface for media source plugins in Drupal, defining methods for metadata handling, source field management, display preparation, and source value retrieval.

methods.name: getMetadataAttributes
methods.description: Returns a list of metadata attributes provided by the media source plugin, such as dimensions, duration, encoding, etc.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific metadata attribute for a given media item.

methods.name: getSourceFieldDefinition
methods.description: Gets the source field definition for a specific media type.

methods.name: createSourceField
methods.description: Creates the source field definition for a media type.

methods.name: prepareViewDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the media type fields for display in the view mode.

methods.name: prepareFormDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the media type fields for display in the form mode.

methods.name: getSourceFieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves the primary value stored in the media source field for a media item.
